topByCalls.query:
-- Get the current LSN from Postgres as a pg_lsn type.
SELECT CASE
    WHEN pg_catalog.pg_is_in_recovery() THEN pg_catalog.pg_last_wal_replay_lsn()
    ELSE pg_catalog.pg_current_wal_lsn()
END AS lsn, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
select count(*) from pg_stat_replication where application_name != $1
SELECT $1
select count(*) from pg_stat_subscription where pid is not null

SELECT state, pg_catalog.to_char(state_change, $1::pg_catalog.text) AS state_change
                FROM pg_stat_activity
                    WHERE backend_type OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) $2::pg_catalog.text
                    AND pid OPERATOR(pg_catalog.!=) pg_catalog.pg_backend_pid()
                    AND usename OPERATOR(pg_catalog.!=) $3::pg_catalog.name
select count(*) from pg_stat_activity where backend_type = $1

SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.sum(active_time), $1)::pg_catalog.float8 AS total_active_time,
            COALESCE(pg_catalog.sum(sessions), $2)::pg_catalog.int8 AS total_sessions
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_database
        WHERE datname NOT IN (
                $3,
                $4,
                $5
            )
SELECT COALESCE(lfc_value, $1) AS count FROM neon.neon_lfc_stats WHERE lfc_key = $2

select "pvpRooms"."id", "pvpRooms"."code", "pvpRooms"."visibility", "pvpRooms"."expiresAt", "pvpRooms"."status", "pvpRooms_members"."data" as "members" from "pvp_room" "pvpRooms" left join lateral (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_array("pvpRooms_members"."userId", "pvpRooms_members"."joinedAt", "pvpRooms_members"."readyAt", "pvpRooms_members"."leftAt") order by "pvpRooms_members"."joinedAt" asc), $3::json) as "data" from (select * from "pvp_room_member" "pvpRooms_members" where "pvpRooms_members"."roomId" = "pvpRooms"."id" order by "pvpRooms_members"."joinedAt" asc) "pvpRooms_members") "pvpRooms_members" on $4 where ("pvpRooms"."status" = $1 or "pvpRooms"."expiresAt" <= $2)
SELECT bucket_le, value FROM neon.neon_perf_counters WHERE metric = $1

-- Returns no rows when get_compute_primary_memory_bytes() returns NULL, causing sql_exporter
-- to NOT emit the metric. This matches autoscaling_metrics behavior.
SELECT bytes FROM (SELECT get_compute_primary_memory_bytes() AS bytes) t WHERE bytes IS NOT NULL
SELECT pg_size_bytes(current_setting($1))
SELECT COALESCE(pg_cluster_size, $1) AS bytes FROM neon.pg_cluster_size()
SELECT pg_catalog.current_setting($1) AS max_connections
SELECT COALESCE(pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_last_wal_receive_lsn(), pg_last_wal_replay_lsn()), $1) AS bytes

-- We use a GREATEST call here because this calculation can be negative. The
-- calculation is not atomic, meaning after we've gotten the receive LSN, the
-- replay LSN may have advanced past the receive LSN we are using for the
-- calculation.

SELECT
  CASE
    -- Primaries do not have replication delay, so report 0
    WHEN NOT pg_catalog.pg_is_in_recovery() THEN $1
    ELSE GREATEST($2, pg_catalog.pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_catalog.pg_last_wal_receive_lsn(), pg_catalog.pg_last_wal_replay_lsn()))
  END AS replication_delay_bytes
SELECT num_requested AS checkpoints_req FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_checkpointer

SELECT
  slot_name,
  CASE
    WHEN wal_status = $1 THEN $2
    ELSE $3
  END AS wal_is_lost
FROM pg_catalog.pg_replication_slots

WITH c AS (SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_object_agg(metric, value) jb FROM neon.neon_perf_counters)

SELECT d.* FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_to_record((SELECT jb FROM c)) AS d(
  file_cache_read_wait_seconds_count numeric,
  file_cache_read_wait_seconds_sum numeric,
  file_cache_write_wait_seconds_count numeric,
  file_cache_write_wait_seconds_sum numeric,
  getpage_wait_seconds_count numeric,
  getpage_wait_seconds_sum numeric,
  getpage_prefetch_requests_total numeric,
  getpage_sync_requests_total numeric,
  compute_getpage_stuck_requests_total numeric,
  compute_getpage_max_inflight_stuck_time_ms numeric,
  getpage_prefetch_misses_total numeric,
  getpage_prefetch_discards_total numeric,
  getpage_prefetches_buffered numeric,
  pageserver_requests_sent_total numeric,
  pageserver_disconnects_total numeric,
  pageserver_send_flushes_total numeric,
  pageserver_open_requests numeric,
  sql_index_corruption_count numeric,
  sql_data_corruption_count numeric,
  sql_internal_error_count numeric,
  ps_corruption_detected numeric,
  temp_file_size_global numeric,
  num_active_safekeepers numeric,
  num_configured_safekeepers numeric,
  max_active_safekeeper_commit_lag numeric
)

topByPlanning.query: select "pvpRooms"."id", "pvpRooms"."code", "pvpRooms"."visibility", "pvpRooms"."expiresAt", "pvpRooms"."status", "pvpRooms_members"."data" as "members" from "pvp_room" "pvpRooms" left join lateral (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_array("pvpRooms_members"."userId", "pvpRooms_members"."joinedAt", "pvpRooms_members"."readyAt", "pvpRooms_members"."leftAt") order by "pvpRooms_members"."joinedAt" asc), $3::json) as "data" from (select * from "pvp_room_member" "pvpRooms_members" where "pvpRooms_members"."roomId" = "pvpRooms"."id" order by "pvpRooms_members"."joinedAt" asc) "pvpRooms_members") "pvpRooms_members" on $4 where ("pvpRooms"."status" = $1 or "pvpRooms"."expiresAt" <= $2)

SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.sum(active_time), $1)::pg_catalog.float8 AS total_active_time,
            COALESCE(pg_catalog.sum(sessions), $2)::pg_catalog.int8 AS total_sessions
        FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_database
        WHERE datname NOT IN (
                $3,
                $4,
                $5
            )

UPDATE "pvp_match"
        SET status = $1,
            "liveState" = $5,
            revision = revision + $6,
            "endedAt" = $2
        WHERE id = $3
          AND revision = $4
        RETURNING id
SELECT extname, extversion, extowner::pg_catalog.int4 FROM pg_catalog.pg_extension
SAVEPOINT $1
SELECT pg_catalog.current_setting($1) AS max_connections
select "rating", "ratingDeviation" from "player_profile" where "player_profile"."userId" = $1 limit $2

SELECT slot_name, (restart_lsn - $1)::pg_catalog.FLOAT8 AS restart_lsn
FROM pg_catalog.pg_replication_slots
WHERE slot_type = $2

UPDATE "pvp_match"
        SET revision = revision + $5,
            "instanceId" = $1,
            "liveState" = CAST($2 AS jsonb)
        WHERE id = $3
          AND revision = $4
          AND status NOT IN ($6, $7)
        RETURNING id
select "username" from "User" where "User"."id" = $1 limit $2
SELECT bucket_le, value FROM neon.neon_perf_counters WHERE metric = $1

DO $$
BEGIN
    IF (
        NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT FROM pg_catalog.pg_trigger
            WHERE tgrelid OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) 'neon_migration.migration_id'::pg_catalog.regclass::pg_catalog.oid
              AND tgname::pg_catalog.name OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) 'neon_migration_id_superuser_check'::pg_catalog.name
        )
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc
            WHERE pronamespace OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) 'neon'::pg_catalog.regnamespace
              AND proname::pg_catalog.name OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) 'neon_check_for_superuser'::pg_catalog.name
        )
    ) THEN
        CREATE TRIGGER neon_migration_id_superuser_check
        BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE
        ON neon_migration.migration_id
        EXECUTE FUNCTION neon.neon_check_for_superuser();
    END IF;
END;
$$
DISCARD SEQUENCES
SELECT COALESCE(pg_cluster_size, $1) AS bytes FROM neon.pg_cluster_size()

-- N.B. keep in sync with compute_tools/src/monitor.rs GET_LSN_QUERY / check() function
SELECT CASE
  WHEN pg_catalog.pg_is_in_recovery() THEN (pg_catalog.pg_last_wal_replay_lsn() - $1)::pg_catalog.FLOAT8
  ELSE (pg_catalog.pg_current_wal_lsn() - $2)::pg_catalog.FLOAT8
END AS lsn

SELECT id, status, revision, "instanceId", "liveState", "textSnapshot", "textId", "inputNonce", "updatedAt", "startedAt", "endedAt", "serverStartAt"
        FROM "pvp_match"
        WHERE id = $1
        LIMIT $2
SELECT extname, extversion, extowner::pg_catalog.int4 FROM pg_catalog.pg_extension

UPDATE "pvp_match"
        SET status = $1,
            "liveState" = CAST($2 AS jsonb),
            revision = revision + $9,
            "instanceId" = $3,
            "serverStartAt" = $4,
            "startedAt" = $5,
            "endedAt" = $6
        WHERE id = $7
          AND revision = $8
        RETURNING id

select "users"."username", "users"."banned", "users_profile"."data" as "profile", "users_pvpRating"."data" as "pvpRating", "users_pvpMatchmakingPreference"."data" as "pvpMatchmakingPreference" from "User" "users" left join lateral (select json_build_array("users_profile"."avatar", "users_profile"."longTermStats") as "data" from (select * from "player_profile" "users_profile" where "users_profile"."userId" = "users"."id" limit $1) "users_profile") "users_profile" on $6 left join lateral (select json_build_array("users_pvpRating"."rating", "users_pvpRating"."deviation") as "data" from (select * from "pvp_rating" "users_pvpRating" where "users_pvpRating"."userId" = "users"."id" limit $2) "users_pvpRating") "users_pvpRating" on $7 left join lateral (select json_build_array("users_pvpMatchmakingPreference"."preferredMode") as "data" from (select * from "pvp_matchmaking_preferences" "users_pvpMatchmakingPreference" where "users_pvpMatchmakingPreference"."userId" = "users"."id" limit $3) "users_pvpMatchmakingPreference") "users_pvpMatchmakingPreference" on $8 where "users"."id" = $4 limit $5

select calls, total_plan_time, mean_plan_time, total_exec_time, mean_exec_time, query
      from pg_stat_statements
      order by total_plan_time desc
      limit $1
